notes:
E-Sys MAX 4.8.9

New
- Badges: earn levels and badges as you code, and share a picture card or a link.
- Car recovery: put a module back the way it was from your backups.
- Service reset and battery registration from Home.
- Click the code in the title bar to copy it for support.
- Free trial with a card: see the charge date and cancel any time from About.

Changes
- Safer coding: coding stops if a safety check cannot finish, and the VCM order is only written when E-Sys says which order is active.
- Module names show in full, also in dark mode.
- Tidier windows and tables, and more texts in German.
- Updates download more reliably.
- Stronger protection under the hood.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
